# snipeit_model (Data Source)

Looks up a single asset model by `id` or exact `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "snipeit_model" "mbp14" {
  name = "MacBook Pro 14\""
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the model. Set it to look up by id.
- `name` (String) Name of the model. Set it to look up by exact name.

### Read-Only

- `category_id` (Number) Id of the category of this model.
- `eol` (Number) End-of-life in months.
- `fieldset_id` (Number) Id of the custom fieldset attached to this model.
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) Id of the manufacturer of this model.
- `min_amt` (Number) Minimum quantity before a low-stock alert triggers.
- `model_number` (String) Manufacturer model number.
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `requestable` (Boolean) Whether assets of this model can be requested.
